scope: first real-image transition only; one training seed/order; fixed pretrained feature extractor and downstream nonlinear rank-8 adapter
encoder: existing locked AugReg IN21k-to-IN1k ViT/APART initialization; 1536D concatenated unit feature; target-data encoder/pool updates zero
split: original train only, known identity components per class, shuffled seed+c; Qfit and Qgate each max(1,floor(groups/10)); S remainder; need >=3 groups
E: original historically reused development val; no test/reserved; no images/features/scores before all selection locks
patient_isolation: UNKNOWN; not a launch blocker for declared development experiment
feature_transform: existing deterministic medical eval transform: bicubic Resize224, ToTensor, Normalize .5
teacher: fresh initial_model/frame, 48 full batch steps lr=1/16 on old S only, no Q or E
memory: reuse original moment compress: 16 synthetic nodes/class, 48 Adam .02 updates on old S only
baseline: same teacher; 48 steps original class-balanced CE + old teacher-correct centered retention
intervention: old memory CE within-class log weights only; fixed nodes and fixed 1/K class mass; original retention weights and coefficient unchanged
proposal: full 48-step differentiable baseline; Qfit old/new macroCE hypergradients; project normalized negative class-balanced gradient onto two nonpositive derivative halfspaces; scale infinity norm <= log(1.25); exactly one proposal, no outer iterations or scan
selection: Qgate point delta_old>=-.01 AND delta_new>=-.01 AND delta_all>0; else baseline; ties baseline
evaluation: only selected + baseline on E; 10000 paired within-class known-component cluster bootstrap; pointwise 95%; original decision() AND gates
query_resource: Qfit and Qgate are additional old/new labeled development resources; actual per-class counts and cached feature bytes reported; not free memory
comparison_limit: baseline has same resource availability but does not optimize query weights; comparison includes query use, not isolated evidence beyond extra supervision
runtime: single neutral supervisor, one GPU0 extraction worker at a time; CPU-only mathematical training; no automatic monitoring or follow-up experiment
finish: publish all outcomes/costs and stop; if long-running, startup delivery only until user next asks
